seo.defaultTitle: HALK — Household Budgeting App, 100% On-Device & Encrypted
seo.description: HALK is a private, on-device household budgeting app. Track income, bills, savings and loans without your data ever leaving your phone. Download the Android app free.

hero.eyebrow: 100% On-Device • Encrypted • No Bank Login Needed
hero.subtitle: HALK helps households plan income, track bills, build savings and manage loans — without ever sending your financial data to a server.

features.title: 100% On-device & encrypted
features.description: Every rupee you track stays on your device in an encrypted local store. Nothing is uploaded, ever.

features.title: Monthly income baseline
features.description: Set your household's monthly inflow once and let HALK track utilization against it automatically.

features.title: Custom budget builder
features.description: Allocate must-pay bills, flexible spend and savings goals with a drag-simple budget builder.

features.title: Savings vault
features.description: Ring-fence a savings goal every month and watch your safe surplus margin grow.

features.title: Loans & borrowings ledger
features.description: Track money you owe or are owed, with due dates and automatic reminders.

features.title: Monthly reports & trends
features.description: Understand spending patterns across months with clean, on-device analytics.

features.title: Biometric lock
features.description: Face ID / fingerprint protects your household's financial data from prying eyes.

features.title: Month-end rollover
features.description: Unused balances roll over automatically so nothing falls through the cracks.

howItWorks.title: Set your monthly income
howItWorks.description: Tell HALK your household's monthly inflow to establish a baseline for the month.

howItWorks.title: Build your budget
howItWorks.description: Allocate must-pay bills, flexible spending and savings goals in minutes.

howItWorks.title: Track as you go
howItWorks.description: Quick-add expenses, watch your safe surplus margin, and stay ahead of due dates.

howItWorks.title: Review & roll over
howItWorks.description: Get a monthly report, then roll leftover balance into next month automatically.

screens.title: Main dashboard

screens.title: Budget builder
screens.description: Allocate every rupee across bills, flexible spend and savings.

screens.title: Quick add expense
screens.description: Log a transaction in seconds without breaking your flow.

screens.title: Loans & borrowings
screens.description: Keep a clean ledger of money owed and money lent.

faq.q: Is my financial data uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. HALK stores everything in an encrypted local database on your device. There is no server sync, so your household data never leaves your phone.

faq.q: Do I need to link my bank account?
faq.a: No. HALK doesn't require bank logins or account linking — you enter income and expenses yourself, keeping you in full control.
Yes, HALK is free to download and use.

faq.q: Why isn't HALK on the Play Store yet?
faq.a: HALK is currently in review for the Play Store. Until then, you can install it directly via the APK on this page.
HALK supports Android 8.0 and above. An iOS version is planned.
Yes, HALK supports local export so your data is never locked in.
